description: Two write-only secrets are typed as plain strings. PutCustomDomainCustomCertificate.key is the private key of a custom certificate and OtlpLogSinkBearerCredentials.token is a bearer token. The spec tags both `x-go-type: secret.Secret`, like BucketCredentials and the log sink passwords that convert already marks sensitive, and STACKIT's Terraform provider marks the private key Sensitive (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/cdn/customdomain/resource.go, read 2026-11-01).
